title: Tiny, cute anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Anchor ring at top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='7' fill='none' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- Shank (vertical stem) -->
  <rect x='46' y='20' width='8' height='50' rx='3' fill='#FF7B54'/>
  <!-- Stock (horizontal bar) -->
  <rect x='30' y='30' width='40' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#6EE7F9'/>
  <!-- Flukes (curved arms) -->
  <path d='M50 68 Q50 88 70 88 Q88 88 88 70' fill='none' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 68 Q50 88 30 88 Q12 88 12 70' fill='none' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Fluke tips (arrow-like points) -->
  <path d='M84 76 L92 90 L76 90 Z' fill='#6EE7F9'/>
  <path d='M16 76 L8 90 L24 90 Z' fill='#6EE7F9'/>
  <!-- Small crown on top -->
  <path d='M44 8 L47 2 L50 7 L53 2 L56 8 Z' fill='#FF7B54'/>
  <!-- Cute face on shank -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#111B3D'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#111B3D'/>
  <path d='M45 52 Q50 57 55 52' fill='none' stroke='#111B3D' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush cheeks -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='50' r='2' fill='#FF6FAE' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='50' r='2' fill='#FF6FAE' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
